description: This file defines WebSocket routes related to project and task real-time updates using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for WebSocket connections, a help route, user validation, and message broadcasting to project or task-specific rooms.

methods.name: dict websocket_help()
methods.description: Provides usage instructions for WebSocket endpoints.

methods.name: ws_projects(websocket: WebSocket, project_id: int, token: str | None = None)
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections for project-level real-time updates, including user validation and message broadcasting.

methods.name: ws_tasks(websocket: WebSocket, task_id: int, token: str | None = None)
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections for task-level real-time updates, including user validation and message broadcasting.
